summary: Focus on major deities and cosmic events (e.g., Lord Shiva, Samudra Manthan), which achieved 99%+ retention.
Hook viewers in the first 15 seconds to fix severe retention drops (e.g., Dadhichi story dropped to 7.24%).
Target longer script lengths (5-6+ minutes) as deeper mythological storytelling holds audience duration better.
Simplify titles to under 60 characters with clear Hindi and English keywords for search optimization.
Avoid obscure or niche storylines until a core subscriber base is established.
Ensure video thumbnails and titles directly align with the core conflict of the story to fix 0-view videos.
